title: nod-first-page: Taskmaster shell, not the Kit demo
description:
# bazaar-lgr.3: / is Taskmaster, not the Kit demo **Goal.** https://taskmaster.dev shows a Taskmaster shell (title + ready-set empty state). The SvelteKit welcome page is gone. ## Acceptance - [ ] GET https://taskmaster.dev/ HTML contains "Taskmaster" and does not contain "Welcome to SvelteKit" - [ ] Page shows a ready-set empty state (READY / PARKED or "nothing ready") — static copy is enough; no live query required - [ ] taskmaster-dev.service still on :5173; one process; DATABASE_URL=file:local.db ## Contract Guest: `/taskmaster-web/src/routes/+page.svelte` is currently: ```

Welcome to SvelteKit

``` Public origin (verified): `ORIGIN="https://taskmaster.dev"` in `/taskmaster-web/.env` Unit: `taskmaster-dev.service` → `bun run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0 --port 5173` Registry: app `taskmaster`, port 5173, VM `8a878070-2da0-4f8a-8dc0-776f3e1cf7db` `python3 scripts/ready.py` lives in agent-plugin-bazaar, **not** on the guest. Do not SSH it from the page. ## Inherited - Ready-set is a query, not a second tracker (`docs/LEARNINGS.md`). First page may be a static empty state. - Skip Storybook; no Chromium this unit. - One VM, one SQLite, dev mode (`docs/taskmaster/ARCHITECTURE.md`). - Do not invent IdentiKey login; hop when auth blocks. ## Out of scope - Drizzle schema for nodes/assignments/evidence - Live `ready.py` / beads on the guest - IdentiKey / better-auth working login - Kernel ADR (`bazaar-lgr.4`) - Snapshot deploy, systemd beyond the existing unit - MetaDev / ingestion beads
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] GET https://taskmaster.dev/ HTML contains Taskmaster and does not contain Welcome to SvelteKit
- [ ] Ready-set empty state is visible (READY/PARKED or nothing ready)
- [ ] vite still on :5173 via taskmaster-dev.service
close_reason:
AC met and verified live on https://taskmaster.dev (guest 8a878070, vite dev :5173).

[x] / is recognizably Taskmaster — ready-set is the page; default Kit demo gone (0 occurrences of 'Welcome to SvelteKit' in SSR output)
[x] Still one process, one SQLite — no schema change, no new service

edges in src/lib/graph.ts, not stored. Verified in-browser: 15/15 text
roles >= 4.5:1 WCAG AA, keyframes animate opacity/transform only, no
banned easings, no horizontal overflow, 0 console errors, desktop +
390px checked. Guest commit 8a8ee6f (no remote yet).
